activities.title: Mystery Detectives
activities.description: Investigate original mysteries, question witnesses, collect evidence, and defend your final theory.

activities.title: Addition & Subtraction Battleship
activities.description: Solve addition and subtraction problems to fire at enemy ships. Choose your board, math mode, and opponent.

activities.title: Multiplication Battleship
activities.description: Practice multiplication facts while hunting hidden ships. Play together or challenge a computer captain.

activities.title: Periodic Table Battleship
activities.description: Find hidden fleets on a real periodic table. Choose elements, solve chemistry challenges, and identify clues. Explore all 118 elements from elementary through high school.

activities.title: Learning Highway
activities.description: Drive a retro arcade highway, steer through correct math answers, earn coins, and unlock vehicles and paint colors as your skills grow.

activities.title: Mathjong: Tile Quest
activities.description: Flip and match fantasy tiles, solve a new math challenge to collect each pair, and earn coins to unlock colorful decks, backgrounds, and effects.

activities.title: MathDrop Four: Connect to Conquer
activities.description: Play a two-player Connect Four challenge where each move must be earned by solving a math problem. Choose grades and math topics individually, customize boards and pieces, and unlock effects as you improve.

activities.title: Math Maze Adventures
activities.description: Help a bee, rover, or explorer reach the goal by solving each math room and choosing the correctly labeled corridor. Explore or race through dynamically generated mazes.

activities.title: Naches Knowledge Showdown
activities.description: Compete in timed quiz-show rounds with 670 questions, including grade-specific Social Studies boards for grades 5–8. Choose your history and civics subtopics, buzz in, wager, and tackle the finale.

activities.title: Valley Geography Quest
activities.description: Explore all 50 states and capitals, choose a corner or half-country region, zoom in on tiny East Coast states, and race the stopwatch to beat your personal best. Includes PNW geography.
activities.mode: Solo · Regional quizzes, map zoom & timed trials

activities.title: A.S.C.E.N.D.A.N.T. Reader
activities.description: Use adjustable reading speed, words-per-view, and checkpoints to practice focused reading.

activities.title: KeyQuest: Typing Evolution
activities.description: Build keyboarding fluency with timed tests, grade-level nonfiction facts, accuracy feedback, and companions that evolve as you practice.

activities.title: Grizzly Rapids
activities.description: Help Naches-inspired grizzlies catch food in six rushing rivers. Switch bears to match vocabulary categories, type approaching words, and improve accuracy as the currents grow faster.

activities.title: Space Type Defender
activities.description: Defend your space station from approaching word-carrying meteors. Complete six increasingly fast missions while practicing grade-adjusted vocabulary, typing speed, and accuracy.

activities.title: Valley Star Scout
activities.description: Explore tonight’s constellations with an offline star atlas, 7-night weather planning, red night vision, science challenges, and an optional phone-only camera sky finder with compass calibration.
activities.mode: Solo • Sky Explorer, Star Hunter, Science Lab & phone AR Finder

activities.title: Science Investigation Lab
activities.description: Explore eight science investigations. Make predictions, run virtual experiments, analyze measurements and graphs, solve calculations, and defend conclusions with evidence.
activities.mode: Solo or small group · Eight investigations

activities.title: CSI: Naches
activities.description: Solve five fictional Yakima Valley science mysteries. Inspect evidence, interview witnesses, run forensic simulations, reconstruct timelines, and defend conclusions with scientific reasoning.
activities.mode: Solo or small group · Five 20–30-minute cases

activities.title: Ecosystem Explorer
activities.description: A planned interactive simulation for food webs, habitats, and environmental changes.

activities.title: Photoshop Skills Studio
activities.description: Future step-by-step photo-editing lessons with visual examples and practice checkpoints.

activities.title: Illustrator Design Lab
activities.description: Future guided vector-design lessons for shapes, paths, typography, and layout.

activities.title: Nachesopoly: Valley Ventures
activities.description: Play a Naches Valley property-trading board game with local businesses, rent, improvements, auctions, trades, computer opponents, and 48 community and opportunity cards. Learn money management and strategy while exploring the valley.

activities.title: Spelling Sprint
activities.description: Race through vocabulary checkpoints using spelling patterns, roots, prefixes, suffixes, and grade-adjusted word challenges.

activities.title: Science Circuit Raceway
activities.description: Power an arcade racer by interpreting forces, circuits, matter, and energy concepts. Change science topics as new tracks unlock.

activities.title: Fitness Quest: Move & Learn
activities.description: Complete instructor-guided activity challenges, warm-up decisions, recovery checks, and movement-skill quests through an adventure map.

activities.title: Strength Lab: Technique Academy
activities.description: Learn weight-room vocabulary, equipment identification, movement technique, spotting principles, and training logs in a coach-supervised program.

activities.title: Playbook Tactics — Basketball
activities.description: Learn basketball strategy through 12 coaching challenges, then position players and animate custom plays in a five-on-five play designer.

activities.title: Yakima Weather Watch
activities.description: Investigate local weather patterns, compare forecast models, read station data, and predict how temperature, wind, and precipitation may change.

activities.title: Bridge Builder Challenge
activities.description: Design and test bridges across 48 engineering missions using wood, steel, cable, and concrete. Reinforce upper and lower trusses, predict outcomes, and solve short engineering challenges.

activities.title: Budget Bites
activities.description: Plan meals, shop on a budget, and explore a new interactive Recipe Box! Practice washing, measuring, chopping, stirring, stove safety and serving through a 12-step kitchen lesson, with reset and nutrition reports.

activities.title: Budget Builder Market
activities.description: Make simulated spending, saving, tax, and opportunity-cost decisions while trying to meet a monthly budget and long-term goals.

activities.title: World Atlas Expedition
activities.description: Future world-map expansion with countries, capitals, flags, continents, and country-identification challenges.

activities.title: Team Scorekeeper — Basketball
activities.description: Coach/staff tool for tracking basketball rosters, A/B/C squads, game scores, player statistics, squad transfers, and CSV/JSON exports. Data stays in the current browser.

activities.title: Valley Life Journey
activities.description: Spin along a winding life-path board, choose a career, manage paychecks and surprises, and build a balanced future through saving, learning, wellbeing, and community.

activities.title: Chess Academy
activities.description: Start with beginner-friendly chess, then try immortal snails, speed-changing hungry snails, and floating tri-level boards. Optional guided lessons.

activities.title: ELA Writing Workshop
activities.description: Build stronger reading responses with guided RACES (grades 5–6) or RACECES (grades 7–8). Practice with original genre stories, collect evidence, revise with writing checklists, and export your paragraph.

activities.title: Crossy Words
activities.description: Hop across lively voxel worlds, avoid traffic and trains, and solve grammar challenges from grades 3–12. Choose your arcade difficulty, unlock 576 character variations, and earn world achievements.

activities.title: Stackline: Dimensional Tic Tac Toe
activities.description: Rotate transparent 3D-style boards, connect 3, 4, or 5 pieces across layers and towers, challenge computer opponents, and solve spatial reasoning puzzles.
activities.mode: Solo vs computer · 2–5 players · Reasoning Lab

activities.title: Math Rush: Endless Run
activities.description: Dash through five changing worlds! Collect coins, jump crates, slide under barriers, dodge trains, and choose the correct math-answer lane. Unlock runners, outfits, hats, props, boards, and trails in the Style Studio. How far can you go?

activities.title: Valley Word Quest: Daily Dash
activities.description: A new word puzzle every day for each grade, with seasonal themes, timed word challenges, daily calendar, win streaks, achievements, and a celebratory finish. Build vocabulary with gradually longer words from grades 3–12.
activities.mode: Solo · One puzzle per grade each day

activities.title: Worksheet Forge
activities.description: Create differentiated math, vocabulary, grammar, and review worksheets with answer keys and printable layouts.

activities.title: Classroom Bingo Builder
activities.description: Turn class vocabulary, math facts, historical events, or science terms into unique bingo boards for print or device play.

activities.title: Exit Ticket Express
activities.description: Build a two- to five-question exit ticket with quick self-checking or printable response slips.

activities.title: Task Card Scoot
activities.description: Digitize classroom task-card sets into randomized stations with timers, answer reveals, and optional printable recording sheets.

activities.title: Word Puzzle Maker
activities.description: Paste spelling or vocabulary lists to generate playable or printable word searches and crosswords with teacher answer keys.

activities.title: Flashcard & Match Studio
activities.description: Build picture, definition, formula, and term cards; switch between flashcards, memory match, and sort-and-pair games.
activities.mode: Solo or shared device · Custom sets

activities.title: Classroom Randomizer
activities.description: Combine a classroom spinner, dice, timers, team generator, and random question picker without requiring student accounts.

activities.title: Rubric & Reflection Studio
activities.description: Draft customizable rubrics, student checklists, and reflection prompts; save locally and print classroom-ready copies.

activities.title: Classroom Escape Room Builder
activities.description: Turn teacher-written clues, codes, and subject questions into a multi-lock digital classroom escape room.

activities.title: Four Corners Challenge
activities.description: Digitize the classic Four Corners activity with projected prompts, four choices, reasons, and discussion rounds.

activities.title: Logic Grid Lab
activities.description: Solve original deduction grids by crossing out clues, comparing possibilities, and explaining each conclusion.

activities.title: Roll & Write Arcade
activities.description: Play digitized dice-and-pencil favorites with number targets, score sheets, probability choices, and turn-based modes.
activities.mode: Solo or local players · Dice games

activities.title: Tangram Table
activities.description: Drag, rotate, and flip tangram pieces to complete silhouettes and learn transformations, symmetry, and geometric reasoning.

activities.title: Timeline Shuffle
activities.description: Put events in order, estimate dates, and connect causes with effects across historical periods and teacher-made sets.

activities.title: Fraction Tiles Lab
activities.description: Build with fraction bars, number lines, decimal grids, and equivalent fractions before solving guided practice challenges.

activities.title: Graph Detective
activities.description: Turn classroom data into graphs, spot misleading scales, and practice mean, median, mode, and data interpretation.

activities.title: Coordinate Pixel Quest
activities.description: Plot ordered pairs to reveal pixel pictures, design graphing puzzles, and practice translations, reflections, and quadrants.

activities.title: Science CER Notebook
activities.description: Organize predictions, observations, diagrams, and claim-evidence-reasoning responses using reusable lab templates.

activities.title: Checkers Academy
activities.description: Learn classic checkers with legal-move hints, mandatory jumps, multi-captures, kings, computer opponents, and tactical puzzle challenges.

activities.title: Playbook Tactics: Multi-Sport Expansion
activities.description: Extend Basketball Playbook Tactics into volleyball rotations, baseball defenses, football formations, soccer movement, and wrestling positional sequences with animated diagrams.

activities.title: Team Scorekeeper: Multi-Sport Expansion
activities.description: Extend Basketball Scorekeeper to volleyball sets and rotations, baseball innings and counts, football drives, soccer events, and wrestling periods and points.

activities.title: Rhythm Rally
activities.description: Tap or press keys to the beat while reading quarter, half, eighth, and sixteenth notes, rests, and changing time signatures.

activities.title: Note Quest: Music Reading Adventure
activities.description: Identify notes on a musical staff to guide an explorer through levels. Add treble, bass, accidentals, intervals, and instrument-specific practice.

activities.title: Virtual Instrument Studio
activities.description: Play keyboard, xylophone, drum pads, and virtual classroom instruments while exploring pitch, volume, scales, harmony, and timbre.
activities.mode: Solo or shared keyboard · Audio on demand

activities.title: Beat Lab: Music Composer
activities.description: Create original rhythms and melodies with a step sequencer, instrument tracks, tempo controls, musical forms, and project export.

activities.title: Ear Training Arcade
activities.description: Listen for higher and lower pitches, match intervals, recognize rhythm patterns, and practice melodic memory with guided difficulty.

activities.title: Music Bingo Builder
activities.description: Make music vocabulary, instrument, symbol, rhythm, and note-name bingo boards for projector, classroom device, or printable play.

activities.title: Band Practice Companion
activities.description: Combine metronome, reference pitches, practice logs, and an optional microphone tuner with clear consent and no recordings sent to servers.

activities.title: Instrument Family Explorer
activities.description: Explore instrument families, listen to original sound samples, compare timbres, and complete listening detective games.
activities.mode: Solo or whole class · Listening lab

activities.title: Conductor’s Challenge
activities.description: Control a virtual ensemble using tempo, meter, rests, dynamics, and expressive cues. See and hear what changes when the conductor leads.

activities.title: Sheet Music Studio
activities.description: Build short original melodies on a staff, check note durations by measure, play them back, and export printable sheet music.

activities.title: Melody Memory Match
activities.description: Listen to brief original melodies, repeat sequences on a virtual instrument, and recognize matching rhythm or pitch patterns.

activities.title: Music History Remix
activities.description: Explore the evolution of musical styles, instruments, and technology using historical timelines, listening comparisons, and creative prompts.
